briefdescription.para: Get Healthy Boot Monitor device node by node INDEX.

detaileddescription.para:
DeviceIndex
Device Node Index
Pointer to requested XPm_Device, NULL otherwise
Requires Node Index Caller should be careful while using this function as it skips the checks for validating the class, subclass and type of the device before and after retrieving the node from the database. Use this only where it is absolutely necessary, otherwise use XPmDevice_GetById() which is more strict and requires 'complete' Node ID for retrieving the handle.
